Respondents** # ** CORRIGENDUM ORDER ** The Commission vide order dated 18.8.2022 in Petition No. 284/GT/2020 had revised the tariff of Dhauliganga Power Station (280 MW) (“the generating station”) for the 2014-19 tariff period after truing up exercise and also approved the tariff of the generating station for the 2019-24 tariff period. 2. It was found that some typographical error has crept into the order that needs to be rectified. The same is rectified in the following manner: - In Page 86, para 134 _– “The Petitioner has claimed NAPAF of 90% in terms of Regulation 50(A)(4) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations and, hence, the same has been_ _Corrigendum to Order dated 18.8.2022 in Petition No.284/GT/2020_ _Page_ **_2_** _of_ **_3_** _considered.”_ Shall be read as _“In terms of Regulation 50(A)(4) of the 2019 Tariff Regulation, the NAPAF of 78% has been considered.”_ 3. Except for the above, all other terms contained in the order dated 18.8.2022 shall remain unaltered. **(Pravas Kumar Singh) (Arun Goyal) (I. S.
